pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-G-signed_to_lapse — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
text: The {term} between {settlement} and {counterpart} ran to its last season and stopped there, and neither court marked the day.

kind: JF-G-signed_to_lapse — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-G-signed_to_lapse — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
text: The {term} binding {settlement} and {counterpart} is {timeband_age}, and it is kept now by clerks who inherited it rather than by anyone who chose it.

kind: JF-G-signed_to_lapse — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-G-signed_to_lapse — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
text: Nothing was repudiated between {settlement} and {counterpart}: {timeband} short wagons, and then somebody weighed them.

kind: JF-G-signed_to_lapse — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-G-signed_to_lapse — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
text: A mediator sat the two courts down over a pact neither had broken, and the {term} was re-cut rather than let go.

kind: JF-G-signed_to_lapse — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-G-signed_to_lapse — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
text: It was signed by hands the market can no longer name, and it kept its word as long as anybody was watching. The parchment went soft at the folds. The wagons came a little short and then a little shorter, season upon season, and the clerks of {settlement} weighed what arrived against what the {term} promised until the ledger would not close. It ended by the calendar and not by anger, and nothing written stands between the two courts now.

kind: JF-G-signed_to_lapse — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-G-signed_to_lapse — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
text: *[dm-only]* On every surface a free eye can reach it reads honored. {settlement} has sent less than it swore through {timeband_span}, and {counterpart}'s watchers sit too far off to weigh it. The default is real, the detection never came, and the pact will end in good standing, which is the ending the record will carry.

kind: JF-G-signed_to_lapse — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-G-signed_to_lapse — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
text: The {route} between {settlement} and {counterpart} is open again, to anything. The captains marked the week the pact lapsed and said nothing further about it. Where a treaty stood there is now distance and habit, and habit forbids nothing.

kind: JF-G-signed_to_lapse — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-G-signed_to_lapse — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
text: The renewal window opened and nobody stood in it. A demand could have been made, a {term} re-cut, the whole arrangement carried another span. And {settlement}'s chancery let the season pass, which the clerks entered as a decision because there was nothing else to enter it as.

kind: JF-G-signed_to_lapse — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-G-signed_to_lapse — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
text: The {term} between {settlement} and {counterpart} was signed long ago and ran short in its later seasons; it has now reached its date and ended, and no agreement stands between the two settlements.

pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-G-succession_to_repudiation — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
text: The old seat swore it; {npc} sits where the oath was given and has not said whether the oath is his.

pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-G-succession_to_repudiation — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
text: {npc} will keep the word the old seat gave, and {counterpart} has stood its captains down.

pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-G-succession_to_repudiation — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
text: {npc} has torn up the treaty his predecessor swore, and every term under it is broken from this week.

kind: JF-G-succession_to_repudiation — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-G-succession_to_repudiation — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
text: The new seat let the date go by without answering it, and the {term} stands on that silence alone, which is all the law requires of it.

kind: JF-G-succession_to_repudiation — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-G-succession_to_repudiation — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
text: The seat changed, and {band} oaths another hand had sworn became questions in the same week; {counterpart} sent no envoys until it heard. The answer came aloud and it was no. The parchment is kept only as evidence now, the terms defaulted from the day of the saying, and the courts have started pricing what a promise out of {settlement} is worth.

kind: JF-G-succession_to_repudiation — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-G-succession_to_repudiation — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
text: The question was never answered at all. No word came, the date passed, and silence honored the oath. A thing the law says plainly, and which the captains of {counterpart} spent a whole season declining to believe.

kind: JF-G-succession_to_repudiation — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-G-succession_to_repudiation — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
text: The charge is not against the treaty; it is against the line. This house has disavowed {band} times before and the entry has sat {timeband_since} in every chancery that keeps such entries, so the refusal that comes back to {settlement}'s next proposal will name the credibility and never the terms, and there will be no arguing with it, because there are no terms to argue.

kind: JF-G-succession_to_repudiation — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-G-succession_to_repudiation — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
text: There was a quiet road and {settlement} did not take it. The herald read the renunciation out in the square and the clerks defaulted every {term} the same hour, with {reason} entered beside it. Nothing was seized and nothing was burned. Only the signature lost its value, and it lost all of it at once.

kind: JF-G-succession_to_repudiation — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-G-succession_to_repudiation — GRAMMAR → GRAMMAR
text: The seat of {settlement} changed and the new holder was asked whether the old oath stood; {npc} disavowed it, and every term under the treaty with {counterpart} is defaulted.

text: {settlement}'s hall has charged the tribute of {counterpart} to its own seat; the book records both and joins neither.

pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-N-strain_to_coup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
text: Not one payment to {counterpart} left {settlement} late, and the hall took the seat from {npc} for exactly that.

kind: JF-N-strain_to_coup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-N-strain_to_coup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
text: The terms were sealed in {settlement} and never read out, and what the town could not read, the town supplied.

kind: JF-N-strain_to_coup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-N-strain_to_coup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
text: The grievance in {settlement}'s hall emptied into the muster field, and the hall has been quiet since it did.

kind: JF-N-strain_to_coup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-N-strain_to_coup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
text: The terms were sealed and the town believed the worst of them, which is customary. Season by season the installments left on time; season by season the standing of the seat that sent them fell; {burden} stood on {settlement} the whole while and the hall grew short. Nothing in the book joins those two columns. Everyone in the hall joined them, and at the verdict the book was what they read out.

kind: JF-N-strain_to_coup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-N-strain_to_coup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
text: Once it was not the tribute at all. {settlement}'s seat lost standing for a named cause ({reason}, exposed and entered), and the clerks can point to the week and to the reason, which is rarer than it sounds. The tribute and the war stood exactly where they had stood. The rest was weather.

kind: JF-N-strain_to_coup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-N-strain_to_coup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
text: The strain reached the books before it reached the square. The seat's counsel and the town's reading came apart, and then collapsed together under a season that frightened both, and the grievance opened in the hall once the wagons had gone out. {npc} fell for a bill another court had written and a treaty required {settlement} to pay.

kind: JF-N-strain_to_coup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-N-strain_to_coup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
text: The other ending is the same arithmetic read later. {settlement} looked at the price, and at the quiet the price had bought, and stopped complaining; the {good} is entered now beside the peace it bought rather than against the seat that paid it. The entry did not move by {band}. The reading did, and the reading is what a verdict is.

kind: JF-N-strain_to_coup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-N-strain_to_coup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
text: {settlement} paid the tribute owed to {counterpart} and the payments are recorded as met; the standing of {settlement}'s seat fell over the same seasons, and the hall has moved against {npc}.

kind: JF-N-burial_to_digup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-N-burial_to_digup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
text: {settlement}'s seat ordered the {wound} with {counterpart} closed, and set the price of the closing in the same decree.

kind: JF-N-burial_to_digup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-N-burial_to_digup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
text: The decree outlasted {timeband} patience: {faction} has waited in the open since it was read, and has asked the seat to unbury it.

kind: JF-N-burial_to_digup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-N-burial_to_digup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
text: {settlement} buried its grudge with {counterpart}; {counterpart} has buried nothing, and a decree binds only the hall that made it.

kind: JF-N-burial_to_digup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-N-burial_to_digup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
text: {settlement} bought the closing of the quarrel at a price its own clerks entered, and a later hall has given the closing back and kept the bill.

kind: JF-N-burial_to_digup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-N-burial_to_digup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
text: {npc} named the {wound}, named its price, and had both read out in the square of {settlement} before witnesses who will outlive the seat that swore it. The rows stayed in the book and stopped being counted when the hall counted {counterpart}: the war party could read them and could not cite them, and the standing grievance read {band} lighter for it. It held past the doubting season. Then a later hall cited them anyway, word for word, and {counterpart}'s book gained the old {wound} back and a new one for the revoking.

kind: JF-N-burial_to_digup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-N-burial_to_digup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
text: The price is the thing that binds it, and where the granary could not answer the decree there was no peace and only a declaration. {npc} promised {counterpart} more {good} than {settlement} had; the clerks entered the shortfall; the carts never left the yard; and the {wound} is exactly where it was, with a broken promise sitting on top of it.

kind: JF-N-burial_to_digup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-N-burial_to_digup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
text: A court can only bury what it believes it is holding. The grain was given, and {counterpart} took the carts and thanked {settlement} for them and kept its quarrel, because the quarrel was never the one that was bought. The price was paid in full against the wrong account, and the {temple} that witnessed the swearing has been asked about it twice since.

kind: JF-N-burial_to_digup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-N-burial_to_digup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
text: The burial closes {settlement}'s own reads of {counterpart}, and once {counterpart} answers in kind it closes {counterpart}'s of {settlement}, and it closes nothing at all in a third hall. {third_party} holds its entry untouched by a peace it was never party to, and reads it at every reckoning. That is why the digging up matters, and why the world's memory is not one court's to close.

kind: JF-N-burial_to_digup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL.md :: JF-N-burial_to_digup — INTERIOR → INTERIOR
text: The seat of {settlement} decreed the grudge with {counterpart} buried and paid the price set for it; {faction} petitioned against the burial, and the seat has revoked it.

kind: JF-CPL-8a: TRADE → POP
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-8a: TRADE → POP
text: Every question at {settlement} this season ends at the granary door, and it ends there because the {route} that fed the town is cut and nothing has taken its place.

kind: JF-CPL-8a: TRADE → POP
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-8a: TRADE → POP
text: {settlement} has a surplus and a road, and {band} have walked to it {timeband_since}; the town took in what it had room for and turned the rest back at the landing, each with the reason written down and given to them.

kind: JF-CPL-8a: TRADE → POP
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-8a: TRADE → POP
text: The gap in {settlement}'s register is the granary arithmetic told again in burials, season by season and in the same hand.

kind: JF-CPL-8a: TRADE → POP
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-8a: TRADE → POP
text: {settlement}'s gate still writes down arrivals it cannot account for, with the {route} shut and no house owning the run; what comes in fits in the margin of the page, and it has never once been nothing.

kind: JF-CPL-8a: TRADE → POP
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-8a: TRADE → POP
text: {settlement} is still burying at the rate the cut {route} set and the rate has not turned with the season: what the import fell by is what the roll falls by, a band behind, and the granary word is still the word that binds.

kind: JF-CPL-8b: POP → TRADE
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-8b: POP → TRADE
text: {settlement} has {band} more mouths than its last count and the {good} carts come oftener than the road was built for; the column that came up the {route} is entered as a trade flow now: the same feet, in a different book.

kind: JF-CPL-8b: POP → TRADE
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-8b: POP → TRADE
text: The talk at {settlement} has stopped calling the {good} run a novelty and calls it the trade; the arrivals wanted more of it than the old road had ever been asked to carry, and the carriers who answered inside {timeband_span} have not gone home.

kind: JF-CPL-8b: POP → TRADE
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-8b: POP → TRADE
text: A stranger at {settlement} looks for the reason a town stands here and does not find it in the ground; the carts were stopping at this meeting of roads before there was anything to stop for, and the town filled in around them.

kind: JF-CPL-8b: POP → TRADE
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-8b: POP → TRADE
text: {settlement} is emptying on the very reckoning that filled it, and the emptying has not slowed; the granary was the true ceiling of the boom, and the roads have been slow to learn it.

kind: JF-CPL-8b: POP → TRADE
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-8b: POP → TRADE
text: The market at {settlement} runs thin and the routes turned elsewhere; the town was wiped out by the {reason} that followed the hungry year, and the trade withered with it.

kind: JF-CPL-8b: POP → TRADE
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-8b: POP → TRADE
text: {settlement} has a plenty that is real and smaller than the road's account of it, and a column at the gate that came on the account; those who came late are entered as unplaced, with the reason given to them honestly.

kind: JF-CPL-9a: TRADE → INFO
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-9a: TRADE → INFO
text: What {settlement} knows of {counterpart} came in with the {good} and is exactly as old as the journey; the brokers price it accordingly and say so on the stamp.

kind: JF-CPL-9a: TRADE → INFO
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-9a: TRADE → INFO
text: Nobody at {settlement} still says {counterpart}'s harvest failed; the carts came in carrying grain and contradiction together, and the say did not outlive them.

kind: JF-CPL-9a: TRADE → INFO
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-9a: TRADE → INFO
text: A stranger asking at {settlement} for word off the {route} is given something {timeband_age} and told plainly that it is; the town has had nothing newer since the season turned, and does not wait for it.

kind: JF-CPL-9a: TRADE → INFO
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-9a: TRADE → INFO
text: {house} at {settlement} acted on a letter that was current when it left {counterpart} and old when it arrived, and is paying for the difference still; the town has learned what a hop costs.

kind: JF-CPL-9a: TRADE → INFO
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-9a: TRADE → INFO
text: {settlement}'s gate keeps the arrivals off the {route} in a list, and the list is why the town never moved on the report about {counterpart}: {band} separate carriers were asked the same question at the same gate, and not one told the story the way it had arrived.

kind: JF-CPL-9a: TRADE → INFO
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-9a: TRADE → INFO
text: The old brokers at {settlement} price a report by the road it came up before they price it by the hand that wrote it: the town has been wrong about {counterpart} often enough to have learned exactly what a journey costs a fact.

kind: JF-CPL-9b: INFO → TRADE
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-9b: INFO → TRADE
text: {settlement}'s dispatch book shows no consignment to {counterpart} {timeband_since}, and the danger the clerks entered against that lane no longer exists: the siege was lifted, and no carter has yet acted on the lifting.

kind: JF-CPL-9b: INFO → TRADE
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-9b: INFO → TRADE
text: The carts out of {settlement} have all turned east on a saying that the {good} is dear there; nothing in the town's own book supports it, and the carts went anyway.

kind: JF-CPL-9b: INFO → TRADE
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-9b: INFO → TRADE
text: {house}'s doors at {settlement} are shut and the books were sound: the word ran that the house was over-extended, the depositors came for their credit at once, and it could not pay what it never owed.

kind: JF-CPL-9b: INFO → TRADE
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-9b: INFO → TRADE
text: The stalls at {settlement} are quoting {house} at the terms they quoted last season: the rumour ran its course in the taverns and never reached the book that sets the price.

kind: JF-CPL-9b: INFO → TRADE
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-9b: INFO → TRADE
text: `[dm-only]` {faction}'s stamp at {settlement} costs it more each season than the {good} it was meant to move: the shortage it announced never appeared on a single manifest.

kind: JF-CPL-9b: INFO → TRADE
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-9b: INFO → TRADE
text: `[dm-only]` {settlement}'s book carries the buying before the saying and each entry proper on its own page: {npc} had the {good} up before the word came, and the word came on schedule.

kind: JF-CPL-10a: TRADE → GRAMMAR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-10a: TRADE → GRAMMAR
text: {settlement} sends {good} to {counterpart} and receives its own in return, written into one document with a direction on every line; the want crossed the line the clerks watch, and the seat sent on the strength of it.

kind: JF-CPL-10a: TRADE → GRAMMAR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-10a: TRADE → GRAMMAR
text: {settlement} and {counterpart} are at peace and mean to stay so, and this town's carters have arranged their year around it; {settlement} came to that court with a draft instead of a grievance, for {reason}.

kind: JF-CPL-10a: TRADE → GRAMMAR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-10a: TRADE → GRAMMAR
text: A stranger who reads {settlement}'s standing instrument with {counterpart} finds no war anywhere behind it; the want of {good} on one side and the surplus of it on the other are the whole of the reason, and both courts were at peace when they wrote.

kind: JF-CPL-10a: TRADE → GRAMMAR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-10a: TRADE → GRAMMAR
text: The draft {settlement} and {counterpart} exchanged is filed at both ends and signed at neither; each court priced the thing for itself, neither price met the other's, and the two valuations sit in the record where the pact would have been.

kind: JF-CPL-10a: TRADE → GRAMMAR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-10a: TRADE → GRAMMAR
text: {settlement} and {counterpart} keep one instrument between them and it carries the {good} term only; the security clause the same want argued for could not stand beside what was already written, and the clerks entered why rather than letting it fall out of the record.

kind: JF-CPL-10a: TRADE → GRAMMAR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-10a: TRADE → GRAMMAR
text: The pact {settlement} proposed to {counterpart} is signed and this town's carters have already arranged their year around it; what crossed the clerks' line was a want, and the want has not gone away because a document answered it.

kind: JF-CPL-10b: GRAMMAR → TRADE
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-10b: GRAMMAR → TRADE
text: {settlement}'s outbound entries for the {good} are written before the season opens, because a term settles what leaves and the clerks have only to date it; the town's whole trade in it reads as a schedule rather than a market.

kind: JF-CPL-10b: GRAMMAR → TRADE
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-10b: GRAMMAR → TRADE
text: {settlement} speaks of {counterpart} now the way it would speak of a town that broke a peace; the deliveries simply stopped, and a term broken over cargo cuts here exactly as one broken over a border would.

kind: JF-CPL-10b: GRAMMAR → TRADE
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-10b: GRAMMAR → TRADE
text: The stalls at {settlement} are thin and the town is not hungry: the {good} goes out under a term that never reaches past the reserve, and the reserve is the whole reason nobody here goes without.

kind: JF-CPL-10b: GRAMMAR → TRADE
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-10b: GRAMMAR → TRADE
text: {counterpart}'s default stands at {settlement} as compliance, because nobody was watching the crossing; the town is the poorer for a fiction that suits everybody who could correct it.

kind: JF-CPL-10b: GRAMMAR → TRADE
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-10b: GRAMMAR → TRADE
text: The {good} no longer comes to {settlement} out of {counterpart} and no quarrel took it away: the term ran its full course through {timeband_span} and expired on its week, the carts kept the lane out of habit, and {timeband_since} the carters go where the terms are.

kind: JF-CPL-10b: GRAMMAR → TRADE
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-10b: GRAMMAR → TRADE
text: {settlement} owes the {good} under a term and has never once been short of it: what the clause takes sits well above the town's own floor, and no season yet has brought the two figures near each other.

kind: JF-CPL-11a: TRADE → INTERIOR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-11a: TRADE → INTERIOR
text: The hall at {settlement} seats a merchant and the books show the order plainly and lawfully: the {good} fortune first, the credit extended to the seat second, the contest {house} won third. Each entry proper on its own page, one hand behind all of them.

kind: JF-CPL-11a: TRADE → INTERIOR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-11a: TRADE → INTERIOR
text: The hall at {settlement} is a founding in the clerks' book and a purchase in the town's mouth, and {house}'s season in the {good} trade stands behind the seating either way.

kind: JF-CPL-11a: TRADE → INTERIOR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-11a: TRADE → INTERIOR
text: There is no vote worth the calling at {settlement} that {house} has not already counted; the takings off the {route} are what put it in a position to count them.

kind: JF-CPL-11a: TRADE → INTERIOR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-11a: TRADE → INTERIOR
text: The grievance entered at {settlement} is the bill for a hall that answers to {house}, and {faction} has been asking {timeband_since} who is to answer for a founding.

kind: JF-CPL-11a: TRADE → INTERIOR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-11a: TRADE → INTERIOR
text: There is nothing in {settlement}'s hall record to point at, which is the shape the thing takes here: {house} asks for nothing openly and is refused nothing.

kind: JF-CPL-11a: TRADE → INTERIOR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-11a: TRADE → INTERIOR
text: The seat of {settlement} carries a grievance without the creditor that earned it: what ruined {house} did not spare the hall that had leaned on it, and {timeband_since} the second half of that arrangement is all the town has.

kind: JF-CPL-11b: INTERIOR → TRADE
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-11b: INTERIOR → TRADE
text: {house} has marked its appetite for {settlement} down a band with the hall's standing written in as the reason; the {good} goes to {counterpart} instead, and the clerks here have an entry for the pricing and none at all for what did not come.

kind: JF-CPL-11b: INTERIOR → TRADE
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-11b: INTERIOR → TRADE
text: The terms at {settlement} are worse this season and nothing was refused to make them so; everyone trading here knows which quarrel did it.

kind: JF-CPL-11b: INTERIOR → TRADE
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-11b: INTERIOR → TRADE
text: Credit closes early at {settlement} and the price is the harder one: the bill for a court in crisis, charged by houses that read the hall before they read the road.

kind: JF-CPL-11b: INTERIOR → TRADE
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-11b: INTERIOR → TRADE
text: It is the oldest counterweight a town has: the crowd's grievance against the seat is also the countinghouse's discount, scored off one page by two readers; {faction} calls it prudence and the hall calls it desertion, and both are reading the same line.

kind: JF-CPL-11b: INTERIOR → TRADE
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-11b: INTERIOR → TRADE
text: The seat at {settlement} keeps two books and read the wrong one aloud; {house} keeps a third, and it is the third that decides whether the {good} moves at all.

kind: JF-CPL-11b: INTERIOR → TRADE
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-11b: INTERIOR → TRADE
text: The hall at {settlement} is in the worst trouble it has been in and the {good} still comes at the ordinary price: {house} reads the road here and not the hall, and its books carry no entry for the quarrel at all.

kind: JF-CPL-12a: FAITH → POP
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-12a: FAITH → POP
text: {settlement} has its quiet, and it has {band} shuttered houses on the temple street; the rite was put down here, the keeping of it cost more than the leaving, and the congregation walked.

kind: JF-CPL-12a: FAITH → POP
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-12a: FAITH → POP
text: Nothing in {settlement}'s record orders the departure and no column stands anywhere in it; the households went one at a time on the ordinary physics of leaving, and only the tax roll noticed the street had emptied.

kind: JF-CPL-12a: FAITH → POP
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-12a: FAITH → POP
text: {settlement} carries a grudge it had no part in earning, along with the households and the trades that brought it: the town took in the persecuted out of {counterpart}.

kind: JF-CPL-12a: FAITH → POP
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-12a: FAITH → POP
text: The shrine road at {settlement} fills for the feast and empties after it: the season is two economies wearing one road, and this town counts the beds while {counterpart} counts the offerings.

kind: JF-CPL-12a: FAITH → POP
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-12a: FAITH → POP
text: The temple street at {settlement} has not refilled {timeband_since}, and the tax roll is where the town first learned it would not.

kind: JF-CPL-12a: FAITH → POP
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-12a: FAITH → POP
text: {settlement} keeps a full tax roll and an unemptied temple street for all that the rite was put down here: the households that kept it stayed, and the cost of leaving stood higher than the cost of keeping quiet.

kind: JF-CPL-12b: POP → FAITH
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-12b: POP → FAITH
text: {settlement} keeps a feast that is not its own: the households out of {counterpart} brought it, and the clerks have entered where it came from honestly and in the same hand as the rest.

kind: JF-CPL-12b: POP → FAITH
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-12b: POP → FAITH
text: The rite the newcomers carried stands on {settlement}'s calendar beside the old ones {timeband_since}; they came for the grain and stayed for want of anywhere better.

kind: JF-CPL-12b: POP → FAITH
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-12b: POP → FAITH
text: {settlement} keeps days it no longer sorts into its own and other people's; it never converted, it stopped remarking which rite it was keeping, and a stranger cannot now tell which of the days on the calendar the town brought with it.

kind: JF-CPL-12b: POP → FAITH
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-12b: POP → FAITH
text: The pews at {settlement} are where the {reason} left them and nobody decided it: the danger emptied the market and filled {temple}, the danger passed and the comfort did what comfort does, and neither motion was anybody's.

kind: JF-CPL-12b: POP → FAITH
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-12b: POP → FAITH
text: A trickle plants nothing: it took {timeband_span} of arrivals out of one place before {settlement}'s calendar would carry their day, and the households that first asked for it had been paying the town's tithes a long while by then.

kind: JF-CPL-12b: POP → FAITH
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-12b: POP → FAITH
text: Nobody at {settlement} under a certain age can say which of the town's feasts came in with the newcomers: the calendar took them {timeband_since}, the clerks entered where each of them came from, and that entry is the only place the difference still lives.

kind: JF-CPL-13a: FAITH → INFO
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-13a: FAITH → INFO
text: {counterpart} still writes {settlement} down as devout and the picture is {timeband_age}; the town changed its patron in a quiet season and announced it to nobody.

kind: JF-CPL-13a: FAITH → INFO
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-13a: FAITH → INFO
text: Every courtesy that comes to {settlement} out of {counterpart} is addressed to the place the old altar made, and nobody here has thought it worth a letter.

kind: JF-CPL-13a: FAITH → INFO
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-13a: FAITH → INFO
text: {counterpart} sits in {settlement}'s books as a house of the faithful, on the strength of a report that said so and has not been renewed; it was honest when it was written, is stale now, and will be acted on regardless.

kind: JF-CPL-13a: FAITH → INFO
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-13a: FAITH → INFO
text: {settlement}'s shrine is shut and stands in {counterpart}'s books as full: the report that said so was honest and is {timeband_age}, and the doors closed after it was written.

kind: JF-CPL-13a: FAITH → INFO
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-13a: FAITH → INFO
text: Belief about a neighbour's gods decays here like belief about anything else: {settlement} is not wrong about {counterpart}, it is late, and the lateness is what the next decision will be made on.

kind: JF-CPL-13a: FAITH → INFO
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-13a: FAITH → INFO
text: {counterpart} has {settlement} written down exactly as {settlement} is: a party came through after the patron changed, wrote what it found at {temple}, and the picture on that side has not had time to go stale.

kind: JF-CPL-13b: INFO → FAITH
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-13b: INFO → FAITH
text: {temple} at {settlement} reads the hunger as wrath and the town believed the reading through {timeband_span}; the granaries emptied all the same, and the harvest that followed was ordinary.

kind: JF-CPL-13b: INFO → FAITH
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-13b: INFO → FAITH
text: {settlement}'s record carries the {reason} in one entry and the reading of the {reason} in another, side by side and separately attributed; the clerks keep them apart deliberately.

kind: JF-CPL-13b: INFO → FAITH
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-13b: INFO → FAITH
text: The reading has cost {temple} more standing at {settlement} than the calamity ever cost the fields, and it is costing still; the ledger charges the reader, and never the god.

kind: JF-CPL-13b: INFO → FAITH
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-13b: INFO → FAITH
text: Nothing {temple} said that year has been revisited at {settlement}, though the rain came when the temple said it would not; the town has gone on keeping the feast.

kind: JF-CPL-13b: INFO → FAITH
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-13b: INFO → FAITH
text: {settlement} keeps no altar and reads no omen: the bad season is entered here as weather, and the town was neither comforted nor charged for it.

kind: JF-CPL-13b: INFO → FAITH
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-13b: INFO → FAITH
text: A stranger at {settlement} is told what the hunger meant before being told how bad it was: the reading is {temple}'s and the town offers it as the town's own, and the entry recording the season says only that the season was bad.

kind: JF-CPL-14a: FAITH → GRAMMAR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-14a: FAITH → GRAMMAR
text: The peace {settlement} keeps with {counterpart} was drafted in neither hall: {temple} stood between them, and the terms are in a hand that answers to no court.

kind: JF-CPL-14a: FAITH → GRAMMAR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-14a: FAITH → GRAMMAR
text: Nobody at {settlement} calls it a treaty. The two towns keep the same feast, and the road between them has been quiet for as long as the feast has been shared.

kind: JF-CPL-14a: FAITH → GRAMMAR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-14a: FAITH → GRAMMAR
text: A stranger notices {settlement}'s chapter house before its guardhouse; the brothers who carry terms down the road to {counterpart} are the busiest men in the place, and nobody here thinks that strange.

kind: JF-CPL-14a: FAITH → GRAMMAR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-14a: FAITH → GRAMMAR
text: The old hands at {settlement} remember when a shared rite was only a shared rite; it has been the working part of the peace with {counterpart} for {timeband_span}, and the two halls have not needed to speak directly in all of it.

kind: JF-CPL-14a: FAITH → GRAMMAR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-14a: FAITH → GRAMMAR
text: {settlement} and {counterpart} keep the same {creed} from opposite sides of a schism, and that is precisely why nothing is signed: the one thing the two towns hold in common is the thing neither can bring to a table.

kind: JF-CPL-14a: FAITH → GRAMMAR
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-14a: FAITH → GRAMMAR
text: The pilgrimage right {settlement} granted is being honoured and the honouring has changed the town. The road fills at the same week each year now, and the inns along it were built after the fact.

kind: JF-CPL-14b: GRAMMAR → FAITH
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_CAUSAL_DOSSIER.md :: JF-CPL-14b: GRAMMAR → FAITH
text: The chapter house on {settlement}'s east road is open by term and not by welcome; the town signed the access away at the war's end, and the door stands open because a clause says so.
