pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: disposition_insular_crossed — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
text: The roads beyond the walls carry {weight} weight in council than they once did.

kind: disposition_insular_crossed — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: disposition_insular_crossed — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
text: The town gives a {answer} answer when outsiders ask it to look beyond itself.

kind: disposition_insular_crossed — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: disposition_insular_crossed — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
text: What outside ties accomplished has made {settlement} lean {lean}.

kind: disposition_insular_crossed — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: disposition_insular_crossed — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
text: The gate is barred at the hour it has always been barred, and the hour has been getting earlier.

kind: disposition_insular_crossed — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: disposition_insular_crossed — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
text: Factors out of {counterpart} say the town hears them politely and buys nothing.

kind: disposition_insular_crossed — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: disposition_insular_crossed — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
text: What the outer roads brought in was weighed against what they carried off, and the weighing settled the temper.

kind: disposition_insular_crossed — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: disposition_insular_crossed — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
text: {settlement} has turned {band} inward; the gates close earlier each year.

kind: disposition_insular_crossed — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: disposition_insular_crossed — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
text: The factors of {house} are lodged outside the walls now, courteously and firmly.

kind: disposition_insular_crossed — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: disposition_insular_crossed — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events

kind: disposition_insular_crossed — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: disposition_insular_crossed — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
text: They want nothing from anyone, which is a policy until it is a weakness.

kind: disposition_insular_crossed — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: disposition_insular_crossed — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
text: The tolls are high and the welcome is thin, and the town calls both prudence.

kind: disposition_insular_crossed — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: disposition_insular_crossed — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
text: The inn by the gate keeps fewer beds each year and calls the shrinkage demand.

pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: disposition_reversal — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events

kind: disposition_reversal — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: disposition_reversal — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events

pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: disposition_reversal — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events

kind: disposition_reversal — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: disposition_reversal — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events

kind: disposition_reversal — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: disposition_reversal — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
text: The old lesson no longer holds; {practice} now draws a {answer} answer.

kind: disposition_reversal — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: disposition_reversal — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
text: The clerks recopied the standing orders on {practice}, and the new copy does not read like the old one.

kind: disposition_reversal — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: disposition_reversal — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
text: Men who argued one way at the last council argued the other way at this one, and said why.

kind: disposition_reversal — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: disposition_reversal — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
text: A turned temper takes a season to be believed and a generation to be forgotten.

kind: disposition_reversal — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: disposition_reversal — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
text: What the victories taught {settlement}, the losses have untaught.

kind: disposition_reversal — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: disposition_reversal — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
text: The same council that voted the levies votes the granaries now.

kind: disposition_reversal — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: disposition_reversal — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
text: A temper is not a ratchet: {settlement}'s appetite has turned back toward where it began, and reads {band}.

kind: disposition_reversal — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: disposition_reversal — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
text: Men who argued for the war argue for the road, and are not embarrassed.

kind: disposition_reversal — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: disposition_reversal — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
text: The town changed its mind slowly, the way towns do, and over the same ledgers.

kind: disposition_reversal — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: disposition_reversal — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: events
text: Neighbours who learned what to expect of {settlement} will be a season late unlearning it.

kind: deity_war_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: deity_war_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
text: {settlement}'s rites of {domain} make a quicker muster easier to defend in council.

kind: deity_war_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: deity_war_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
text: The local rites make a quicker muster easier to defend in council.

kind: deity_war_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: deity_war_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
text: Voices of restraint find less purchase in the court shaped by this worship.

kind: deity_war_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: deity_war_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
text: The rites do not order wars; they make restraint harder to argue.

kind: deity_war_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: deity_war_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
text: Local worship has lowered the court’s bar for arms.

kind: deity_war_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: deity_war_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
text: The {temple} blesses the muster and does not bless the waiting, and the council has noticed which is which.

kind: deity_war_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: deity_war_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
text: It is said in the market that a captain wanting a hearing should ask for it on a feast day.

kind: deity_war_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: deity_war_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
text: The observance keeps a calendar with more days for arms in it than its neighbours' calendars hold.

kind: deity_war_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: deity_war_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
text: The {temple} of {settlement} keeps a war god's calendar, and the bar for a quarrel sits {band} lower for it.

kind: deity_war_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: deity_war_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
text: The chantry blesses the muster before the harvest, and has for a generation.

kind: deity_war_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: deity_war_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
text: Priests who speak of restraint find thin congregations here.

kind: deity_war_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: deity_war_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
text: It is not that the altar orders wars; it is that it has never argued against one.

kind: deity_war_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: deity_war_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
text: A town takes its temper from whatever it prays over.

kind: deity_war_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: deity_war_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
text: The {temple}'s great feast falls when the roads dry, which is also when columns move.

kind: deity_peace_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: deity_peace_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
text: {settlement}'s harvest rites leave its court {band} slower to muster.

kind: deity_peace_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: deity_peace_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
text: The local rites make another season easier to defend than another campaign.

kind: deity_peace_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: deity_peace_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
text: The court sets the cost of war beside its trade in {good}, a reckoning no captain likes to hear.

kind: deity_peace_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: deity_peace_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
text: Local worship has never forbidden war; it has made war look expensive.

kind: deity_peace_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: deity_peace_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
text: Where harvest rites shape the court, a grievance is more likely to wait another season.

kind: deity_peace_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: deity_peace_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
text: The {temple} keeps a calendar full of sowing days and thin on marching days, and the council keeps the calendar.

kind: deity_peace_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: deity_peace_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
text: Travellers say the town will hear a grievance out and then ask what it would cost to wait.

kind: deity_peace_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: deity_peace_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
text: Where the harvest rites set the year, a muster called at sowing argues against the whole calendar.

kind: deity_peace_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: deity_peace_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
text: {settlement}'s {temple} keeps the harvest rites, and its court is {band} slower to muster.

kind: deity_peace_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: deity_peace_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
text: The pews are full at sowing and the drill ground is empty.

kind: deity_peace_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: deity_peace_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
text: The chapter house prices a war in seed {good}, which is a price no captain likes to hear.

kind: deity_peace_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: deity_peace_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
text: The altar has never forbidden a war; it has merely made one look expensive.

kind: deity_peace_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
pool: RECEIPT_POOLS_LEGACY.md :: deity_peace_pressure — R2 receipt sentence — significance: notable — desk: faith
